candidateSegments.teachingRole: Firing produces backward motion plus rotation; motivates torque and point-of-application model.

observed.before: Vehicle rests facing wall with barrel above wheelbase.
observed.action: Firing is followed by rearing, backward rolling and overturning.
observed.result: Vehicle position and orientation both change.

claimLimits: Reuse of M27 same source is deliberate return to interaction after adding rotational state, not unrelated montage.
Do not infer center of mass, force magnitude, exact lever arm or one torque cause from pixels.
Ground contacts and gravity also act; isolate one force application only in own model.

annotationPlan.target: Vehicle body contour and rotation arc; label observed turn, not hidden measured torque.

annotationPlan.tracking: These inspected sample frames are planning evidence, not per-frame tracking. Follow actual target; hide at occlusion/out-of-frame; clear at cut.
annotationPlan.captionClearance: Fixed bottom-centre captions and game UI protected; foreground callout should not cover the action.
